Package com.csse3200.game.cards.runtime

Record Class ResolvedCard

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.csse3200.game.cards.runtime.ResolvedCard
Record Components:
instanceId - stable ID of the exact owned copy
cardId - shared card definition ID
name - resolved display name
description - resolved rules text
cost - resolved energy cost
type - inherited card category
rarity - resolved rarity
target - inherited target type
effects - resolved effects in execution order
texturePath - inherited artwork path
upgraded - whether upgraded values were selected
public record ResolvedCard(String instanceId, String cardId, String name, String description, int cost, CardType type, Rarity rarity, TargetType target, List<EffectConfig> effects, String texturePath, boolean upgraded) extends Record
Immutable, runtime-ready card values shared by presentation and gameplay consumers.

Effect data is defensively copied both when this record is created and when it is read. This prevents consumers from mutating either this snapshot or the source CardConfig.
